items.title: Vince DiMartino interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 8, 2025
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Oh I played with him many times.

ctx.x: everybody else had so much training and I was self-trained almost. And my trumpet teacher was absolutely wonderful. He understood where I was, just like my band director did. He was great. So I’ve always lacked confidence even though I was first trumpet in the jazz band, you know I played first in the second orchestra, I played in the best brass quintet, but I didn’t have the confidence that should go with that you know. So when I finally realized that I could play some, it was great you know. And I had moments…
You know there’s a small number of people I’ve met over the years, including people like Milt Hinton —
Oh I played with him many times.
